description: Seed candidate list: the 25 wallets the public operator (0x53a42d2d0fdd60bf8f833fb94841349095a74024) was observed copying on Robinhood Chain, with our research classifications from docs/research/whale-profiles.md. The scorer (scorer/wallet_scorer.py) re-derives classifications from live data into data/targets.json; these are priors, not ground truth. 'unrated' = single observed episode, no profile.
fleet_note: Wallets 0x8A71..., 0x23ad..., 0x0B64..., 0x453f..., 0xbDcE... and 0xf4d8... are one bot fleet: every Relay buy priced for them was funded by a single EOA, 0xf70da97812CB96acDF810712Aa562db8dfA3dbEF, via RelayRouter. Treat fleet membership as correlated exposure, not diversification.
